title: Olive and the Big Barn
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — review of split digraphs and early alternative pronunciations.

pages.brief: Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar stepping together into a dim, dusty old barn, sunlight cutting through gaps in the wood.
Olive the owl looking up at a small nest tucked into the barn rafters.
Olive the owl standing still, gazing up at the nest, while Fig keeps walking ahead unseen.
Fig the caterpillar moving further into the barn, with Olive now alone, out of sight.
Olive the owl turning her head, looking around an empty patch of the barn, no sign of Fig.
Olive the owl calling out loudly, beak open, inside the shadowy barn.
Fig the caterpillar pausing mid-step, antennae lifted, listening to a distant call.
Fig the caterpillar moving back the way it came through the barn.
Fig the caterpillar arriving beside Olive the owl, who is still standing under the rafters.
Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar standing together happily, the nest visible above them.
